description: Integration manifest for namespaced engine classes under includes/. Production code must reach every engine marked 'wired'. Unwired engines are listed explicitly so no capability is claimed from an unreferenced class.

engines.note: Used as the bounded parser adapter (multipart, XML, normalization). Enforcement policy remains in GWQSH_Firewall.

engines.replacement: GWQSH_Two_Factor::consume_totp() uses a compare-and-swap on gwqsh_2fa_last_slice for the same replay guard; GWQSH_Passkeys validates origin/challenge/counter through the bundled WebAuthn verifier.
engines.note: Do not claim extra authentication protection from this class. Regression tests cover the class itself only.

engines.replacement: GWQSH_Secure_HTTP::allowed() pins each outbound service to a fixed host and path (hooks.slack.com etc.) and is stricter than DNS-based validation.
engines.note: Active webhook destination validation exists; this class is not part of it.

engines.replacement: GWQSH_Scan_Engine::inspect() -> GWQSH_Malware_Analyzer::analyze() (token analysis, signatures, archive inspection).
engines.note: Scanner scheduling and results flow through GWQSH_File_Integrity/GWQSH_Scan_Engine only.

engines.replacement: GWQSH_Vulnerabilities::match()/evaluate()/scoped_patches() drives virtual patching and is called from GWQSH_Firewall::inspect()/inspect_rest().
engines.note: Virtual patches are data-only signed advisories; no external vendor feed is configured.

engines.replacement: GWQSH_Crypto::verify_ed25519() plus the feed verification in GWQSH_Signatures and GWQSH_Vulnerabilities.
engines.note: Requires the sodium extension; the plugin has a WordPress-polyfill path. Not exercised by this harness (no sodium in the test runtime).

engines.replacement: GWQSH_Signatures::update()/rollback() and GWQSH_Vulnerabilities::update()/accept()/rollback() implement staged fetch, verify, activate and rollback.
engines.note: No production publisher or trusted public key is configured; nothing in this repository operates a live intelligence network.
Broad automatic database rewriting is intentionally not enabled.

engines.replacement: GWQSH_Backup_Engine plus includes/trait-gwqsh-database-restore.php implement staged import, verification and cutover.
engines.note: Full-site disaster recovery has not been validated end to end in this session.
